title: Lovely food tour in Seville
text: Our guide, Pilar, was amazing!! We would definitely do it again just to have her guide us around telling us all about the history. All food and drinks were great and we had a lovely group to do it with as well.
author: D5718UUnicolew

title: Fun and informative
text: Pilar was phenomenal. She’s informative and personable, and provides wonderful insights into Seville’s food and wine culture.
author: willbE4314ES

title: Yum
text: Great host! Really knew her stuff and gave us  great experience. Good group size too.
author: Sightseer46316459919

title: Great experience getting...
text: Great experience getting to not only try local food and wine, but also getting to meet people from other countries and some of the locals!
author: Courtney_W

title: Great tour thanks Elena
text: Fabulous tour hosted by Elena whose passion for her beloved Seville shone through. She shared great food, fabulous local wines and a real insight to the history of gastronomy in Seville. We thoroughly enjoyed and recommend this tour and Elena.
author: margaretwR317QJ

title: Amazing
text: Elena was wonderful!!!  We learned so much about the food, the area and the drinks.
author: loritG5425MW

title: Alex is the best!
text: Alex was such a great guide! Lots of energy,  knowledge and enthusiasm! We went to some amazing places that I would not have found on my own.

title: Book it
text: Alex was wonderful. We ate so much food, even with them accommodating me being both pescatarian and gluten free, and finally got to taste some sherry wines. On top of that we met a an amazing group of people. Highly recommend!

title: Alex is the man!
text: Magnificent tour with Alex.  The group was really fun and the food was terrific.
